Clave:
botchjob.medievalfantasyquestrewards:A highly potent resurrection potion capable of bringing the dead back to life.

Unfortunately, those brought back may suffer from brain damage, blindness, or progressive madness. They will also experience mild amnesia, forgetting some recent memories and social interactions.

Original:
A highly potent resurrection potion capable of bringing the dead back to life.

Unfortunately, those brought back may suffer from brain damage, blindness, or progressive madness. They will also experience mild amnesia, forgetting some recent memories and social interactions.

Espanol:
Una poción de resurrección muy potente que devuelve la vida a los muertos.

Clave:
botchjob.medievalfantasythemedrelicquests:questDescription->You've received word of a stolen airship on the run from the empire. it may contain records with information about [relic_name]. You can signal the fugitive pilot to land at [map_definite].

Clave:
botchjob.medievalfantasythemedrelicquests:questDescription->[asker_nameDef], [asker_faction_leaderTitle] of [asker_faction_name], has discovered an ancient stronghold a long distance away. [asker_pronoun] believes it contains ancient texts that may have information about the relic known as [relic_name].

[asker_nameDef] can't spare people to look into it, but hopes you can help by supplying exactly [colonistCount] [colonistsSingularOrPlural] to carry out the investigation.

The stronghold contains unknown threats and is also being sought by [asker_nameDef]'s enemies, [enemyFaction_name].

[asker_pronoun] will send an airship to pick up your colonists, bring them to the location, and take them home afterward. They will be fed and tended to en-route.

Once you have landed, you must decipher all ancient texts in the stronghold within [timeoutTicks_duration].

The stronghold contains unknown threats and is also being sought by [asker_nameDef]'s enemies, [enemyFaction_name].

Espanol:
questDescription->[asker_nameDef], [asker_faction_leaderTitle] de [asker_faction_name], ha descubierto un bastión antiguo muy lejano. [asker_pronoun] cree que contiene textos antiguos con información sobre la reliquia [relic_name].

[asker_nameDef] no puede enviar gente a investigarlo, pero espera que aportes exactamente [colonistCount] [colonistsSingularOrPlural] para hacerlo.

El bastión contiene amenazas desconocidas y también lo buscan los enemigos de [asker_nameDef], [enemyFaction_name].

[asker_pronoun] enviará un dirigible para recoger a tus colonos, llevarlos al lugar y devolverlos a casa después. Durante el viaje recibirán comida y atención médica.

Tras aterrizar, debes descifrar todos los textos antiguos del bastión en [timeoutTicks_duration].

dubwise.dubsbadhygiene:After 2 days of toxic fallout the buildup will contaminate any water storage tanks connected to water wells.

Prepare by creating a reserve of water and then using a valve to disconnect the wells to protect the water from contamination before it is too late.

Original:
After 2 days of toxic fallout the buildup will contaminate any water storage tanks connected to water wells.

Prepare by creating a reserve of water and then using a valve to disconnect the wells to protect the water from contamination before it is too late.

You can also use a deep well to access uncontaminated water, or install a water treatment system which will eliminate all contamination from water reserves.
Espanol:
Después de 2 días de lluvia tóxica, la acumulación contaminará cualquier tanque de almacenamiento de agua conectado a los pozos de agua.

Prepárate creando una reserva de agua que te permita desconectar con una válvula los pozos para proteger el agua de la contaminación antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

1: Save your game immediately after pressing confirm

Original:
Steps:

1: Save your game immediately after pressing confirm

Clave:
dubwise.dubsbadhygiene:Switch the mod into a simplified mode which removes pipes, water and sewage management, and any buildings and jobs not directly related to hygiene and thirst.

Switch the mod into a simplified mode which removes pipes, water and sewage management, and any buildings and jobs not directly related to hygiene and thirst.

Clave:
fluffy.pharmacist:Security margin used when treating diseases. 

If immunity is lower than disease progress plus this margin (and severity is higher than the minimum threshold), the disease is treated as a life-threatening injury.

For example, if a disease has progressed 75%, immunity is at 80%, and the margin is 10%, the disease will be classed as life-threatening. If the threshold was 5%, the disease would be classed as a major injury instead.Fluffy.Pharmacist.DiseaseMargin.Tip
Original:
Security margin used when treating diseases. 

If immunity is lower than disease progress plus this margin (and severity is higher than the minimum threshold), the disease is treated as a life-threatening injury.

For example, if a disease has progressed 75%, immunity is at 80%, and the margin is 10%, the disease will be classed as life-threatening. If the threshold was 5%, the disease would be classed as a major injury instead.
Espanol:
Margen de seguridad utilizado al tratar enfermedades.

Si la inmunidad es menor que el progreso de la enfermedad más este margen (y la gravedad es mayor que el umbral mínimo), la enfermedad se trata como una lesión mortal.

Por ejemplo, si una enfermedad ha progresado un 75%, la inmunidad está al 80% y el margen es del 10%, la enfermedad se clasificará como mortal. Si el umbral fuera del 5%, se clasificaría como una herida grave en su lugar.

matathias.empire:A settlement's Offensive or Defensive military level is the number actually used in battles, derived from the squad or - if no squad - half of the level cap.
	
The level cap determines the strongest squad this settlement can field.

All military level bonuses raise the cap, not the effective level.FCSettlementMilLevelExplain
Original:
A settlement's Offensive or Defensive military level is the number actually used in battles, derived from the squad or - if no squad - half of the level cap.
	
The level cap determines the strongest squad this settlement can field.

All military level bonuses raise the cap, not the effective level.
Espanol:
El nivel militar ofensivo o defensivo de un asentamiento es el número que se usa realmente en las batallas, derivado del escuadrón o —si no hay escuadrón— de la mitad del límite de nivel.

El límite de nivel determina el escuadrón más fuerte que este asentamiento puede desplegar.

Todas las bonificaciones de nivel militar elevan el límite, no el nivel efectivo.

At tax time, you will receive a random selection of items, with a total value equal to or less than the Random Tithe Budget. You can add or remove items to the list to control what is or isn't selected.

If the lowest value item in the list has a higher value than your Random Tithe Budget, or if there are no items to select from, then the budget is carried over to the next tax period.

Random tithes are considered after your explicit tithe items are paid. If your explicit tithes consume most of the projected tithe budget, the allocated Random Tithe Budget may not actually be available at tax time.
Espanol:
A la hora de los impuestos, recibirás una selección aleatoria de objetos, con un valor total igual o inferior al presupuesto de diezmo aleatorio. Puedes añadir o quitar objetos de la lista para controlar qué se selecciona y qué no.

Si el objeto de menor valor de la lista tiene un valor superior a tu presupuesto de diezmo aleatorio, o si no hay objetos entre los que elegir, el presupuesto se traslada al siguiente periodo de impuestos.

matathias.empire:The Road Builder automatically connects your Empire settlements with roads using a Minimum Spanning Tree algorithm, which is recalculated (with caching) on the following events:
 - each time a settlement is founded or lost
 - when you research a new level of roads
		
This requires computing pathfinding costs between many pairs of settlements, which can be expensive with many settlements, or with very sparse settlements.

By default, this computation runs on a background thread to avoid freezing the game. If you experience issues with threading, you can disable it and optionally spread the computation across multiple ticks instead.
		
Spreading out the computation will reduce the impact on performance, but no roads will build until the MST is fully constructed. So the more you throttle the algorithm, the longer it will take for your roads to start building.FCSettingRoadBuilderDesc
Original:
The Road Builder automatically connects your Empire settlements with roads using a Minimum Spanning Tree algorithm, which is recalculated (with caching) on the following events:
 - each time a settlement is founded or lost
 - when you research a new level of roads
		
This requires computing pathfinding costs between many pairs of settlements, which can be expensive with many settlements, or with very sparse settlements.

By default, this computation runs on a background thread to avoid freezing the game. If you experience issues with threading, you can disable it and optionally spread the computation across multiple ticks instead.
		
Spreading out the computation will reduce the impact on performance, but no roads will build until the MST is fully constructed. So the more you throttle the algorithm, the longer it will take for your roads to start building.
Espanol:
El Constructor de carreteras conecta automáticamente tus asentamientos del Imperio con carreteras usando un algoritmo de Árbol de Expansión Mínima, que se recalcula (con caché) en los siguientes eventos:
 - cada vez que se funde o se pierde un asentamiento
 - cuando investigas un nuevo nivel de carreteras

Esto requiere calcular los costes de pathfinding entre muchos pares de asentamientos, lo que puede ser costoso con muchos asentamientos, o con asentamientos muy dispersos.

Por defecto, este cálculo se ejecuta en un hilo en segundo plano para evitar que el juego se congele. Si tienes problemas con los hilos, puedes desactivarlo y, opcionalmente, repartir el cálculo a lo largo de varios ticks.

Repartir el cálculo reducirá el impacto en el rendimiento, pero no se construirá ninguna carretera hasta que el AEM esté completamente construido. Así que cuanto más limites el algoritmo, más tardarán en empezar a construirse tus carreteras.

Clave: matathias.empire:The land is strangled by thick vegetation as trees reach for the sky, ensuring little light reaches the treacherous grounds. Disease is rampant and frequent.FCDescTropicalSwamp

Clave:
matathias.empire:The measure of the Settlement's overall happiness.

A high happiness means that any internal conflict within the settlement will lean heavily to your favor.FCSettlementHappinessDesc
Original:
The measure of the Settlement's overall happiness.

A high happiness means that any internal conflict within the settlement will lean heavily to your favor.
Espanol:
La medida de la felicidad general del asentamiento.

Una felicidad alta significa que cualquier conflicto interno dentro del asentamiento se inclinará en gran medida a tu favor.

Clave:
matathias.empire:The measure of the Settlement's overall loyalty.

The loyalty of a settlement determines how willing the settlement is to listen to you. A high loyalty will reduce the chance of defection.FCSettlementLoyaltyDesc
Original:
The measure of the Settlement's overall loyalty.

The loyalty of a settlement determines how willing the settlement is to listen to you. A high loyalty will reduce the chance of defection.
Espanol:
La medida de la lealtad general del asentamiento.

La lealtad de un asentamiento determina hasta qué punto está dispuesto a escucharte. Una lealtad alta reducirá la probabilidad de deserción.

Clave:
matathias.empire:The measure of the Settlement's overall prosperity.

The prosperity of a settlement directly correlates with the production of resources (e.g. 50% prosperity = 50% production). Prosperity drifts toward a target determined by the settlement's happiness, loyalty, and unrest.FCSettlementProsperityDesc
Original:
The measure of the Settlement's overall prosperity.

The prosperity of a settlement directly correlates with the production of resources (e.g. 50% prosperity = 50% production). Prosperity drifts toward a target determined by the settlement's happiness, loyalty, and unrest.
Espanol:
La medida de la prosperidad general del asentamiento.

La prosperidad de un asentamiento se correlaciona directamente con la producción de recursos (p. ej., 50% de prosperidad = 50% de producción). La prosperidad deriva hacia un objetivo determinado por la felicidad, la lealtad y el descontento del asentamiento.

Clave:
matathias.empire:The measure of the Settlement's overall unrest.

The higher unrest grows, the more likely dangerous events internal in your Settlement will spark. Let it grow too high, and a Settlement-wide revolt may grow.FCSettlementUnrestDesc
Original:
The measure of the Settlement's overall unrest.

The higher unrest grows, the more likely dangerous events internal in your Settlement will spark. Let it grow too high, and a Settlement-wide revolt may grow.
Espanol:
La medida del descontento general del asentamiento.

Cuanto más crece el descontento, más probable es que surjan eventos internos peligrosos en tu asentamiento. Si lo dejas crecer demasiado, podría estallar una revuelta en todo el asentamiento.

Clave: matathias.empire:The measure of the faction's overall happiness. A high happiness means that any internal conflict within the settlement will lean heavily to your favor.FCFactionHappinessDesc
Original: The measure of the faction's overall happiness. A high happiness means that any internal conflict within the settlement will lean heavily to your favor.
Espanol: La medida de la felicidad general de la facción. Una felicidad alta significa que cualquier conflicto interno dentro del asentamiento se inclinará en gran medida a tu favor.

Clave: matathias.empire:The measure of the faction's overall loyalty. The loyalty of a settlement determines how willing the settlement is to listen to you. A high loyalty will reduce the chance of defection.FCFactionLoyaltyDesc
Original: The measure of the faction's overall loyalty. The loyalty of a settlement determines how willing the settlement is to listen to you. A high loyalty will reduce the chance of defection.
Espanol: La medida de la lealtad general de la facción. La lealtad de un asentamiento determina hasta qué punto está dispuesto a escucharte. Una lealtad alta reducirá la probabilidad de deserción.

Clave: matathias.empire:The measure of the faction's overall prosperity. The prosperity of a town directly correlates with the production of resources. 50% prosperity = 50% production. If prosperity is damaged, it will slowly accumulate over time.FCFactionProsperityDesc
Original: The measure of the faction's overall prosperity. The prosperity of a town directly correlates with the production of resources. 50% prosperity = 50% production. If prosperity is damaged, it will slowly accumulate over time.
Espanol: La medida de la prosperidad general de la facción. La prosperidad de una población se correlaciona directamente con la producción de recursos. 50% de prosperidad = 50% de producción. Si la prosperidad sufre daños, se acumulará lentamente con el tiempo.

Clave: matathias.empire:The measure of the faction's overall unrest. The higher unrest grows, the more likely dangerous events internal in your faction will spark. Let it grow too high, and a faction-wide revolt may grow.FCFactionUnrestDesc
Original: The measure of the faction's overall unrest. The higher unrest grows, the more likely dangerous events internal in your faction will spark. Let it grow too high, and a faction-wide revolt may grow.
Espanol: La medida del descontento general de la facción. Cuanto más crece el descontento, más probable es que surjan eventos internos peligrosos en tu facción. Si lo dejas crecer demasiado, podría estallar una revuelta en toda la facción.

Clave: matathias.empire:The rugged beauty of this land is matched only by its inhospitability. Marshes dot the landscape, as do frequent packs of migrating herbivores and the predators that hunt them.FCDescColdBog
Original: The rugged beauty of this land is matched only by its inhospitability. Marshes dot the landscape, as do frequent packs of migrating herbivores and the predators that hunt them.

Clave: matathias.empire:The settlement has a good number of structures — largely production oriented — as well as dedicated storehouses, and busy workers scurry between them. A modest wall protects the settlement.FCTownLevel3
Original: The settlement has a good number of structures — largely production oriented — as well as dedicated storehouses, and busy workers scurry between them. A modest wall protects the settlement.
Espanol: El asentamiento tiene un buen número de estructuras —principalmente orientadas a la producción— así como almacenes dedicados, y trabajadores atareados corretean entre ellas. Un muro modesto protege el asentamiento.

Clave: matathias.empire:The settlement is dominated by a few large structures, but it is still quite small. A number of sandbags and barricades ring the outside.FCTownLevel2
Original: The settlement is dominated by a few large structures, but it is still quite small. A number of sandbags and barricades ring the outside.
Espanol: El asentamiento está dominado por unas pocas estructuras grandes, pero sigue siendo bastante pequeño. Numerosos sacos terreros y barricadas rodean el exterior.

Clave: matathias.empire:The settlement is now being upgraded...FCStartUpgradeSettlement
Original: The settlement is now being upgraded...
Espanol: El asentamiento se está mejorando ahora...

Clave: matathias.empire:The settlement is reasonably large, and well organised, with a number of industrial buildings clustered together to maximize efficiency. A thick wall and internal defenses protect the settlement from attack.FCTownLevel4
Original: The settlement is reasonably large, and well organised, with a number of industrial buildings clustered together to maximize efficiency. A thick wall and internal defenses protect the settlement from attack.
Espanol: El asentamiento es razonablemente grande y está bien organizado, con varios edificios industriales agrupados para maximizar la eficiencia. Un grueso muro y defensas internas protegen el asentamiento de los ataques.

Clave: matathias.empire:The settlement itself is simply a small cluster of buildings grouped around a central structure.FCTownLevel1
Original: The settlement itself is simply a small cluster of buildings grouped around a central structure.
Espanol: El asentamiento en sí no es más que un pequeño grupo de edificios agrupados en torno a una estructura central.

Clave: matathias.empire:The settlement level has decreased by one.FCSettlementDeleveledRaid

Clave: matathias.empire:The settlement requires a higher military level to use that fire support!FCRequiresHigherMilLevel

Clave: matathias.empire:The settlement requires an artillery outpost to be built to use that firesupport optionFCRequiresArtilleryOutpost

Espanol: El escuadrón está ocupado y no puede mejorarse ahora mismo.

Clave: matathias.empire:The station dominates the local orbital space; a sprawling complex of interconnected rings and spars, humming with industry. Layered shielding and weapons platforms ensure nothing approaches unchallenged.FCTownLevel_Orbital_5
Original: The station dominates the local orbital space; a sprawling complex of interconnected rings and spars, humming with industry. Layered shielding and weapons platforms ensure nothing approaches unchallenged.
Espanol: La estación domina el espacio orbital local; un extenso complejo de anillos y largueros interconectados, zumbando de actividad industrial. Un blindaje en capas y plataformas de armas garantizan que nada se acerque sin oposición.

Clave: matathias.empire:The station has expanded into a respectable orbital platform, with dedicated production modules, rotating crew quarters, and an array of solar collectors stretching outward.FCTownLevel_Orbital_3
Original: The station has expanded into a respectable orbital platform, with dedicated production modules, rotating crew quarters, and an array of solar collectors stretching outward.
Espanol: La estación se ha expandido hasta convertirse en una respetable plataforma orbital, con módulos de producción dedicados, alojamientos rotatorios para la tripulación y una serie de colectores solares que se extienden hacia el exterior.

Clave: matathias.empire:The station is little more than a pressurized habitat module with a handful of docking ports, its hull still gleaming from recent construction.FCTownLevel_Orbital_1
Original: The station is little more than a pressurized habitat module with a handful of docking ports, its hull still gleaming from recent construction.
Espanol: La estación es poco más que un módulo de hábitat presurizado con un puñado de puertos de atraque, su casco aún reluciente por la reciente construcción.

Clave: matathias.empire:The sun has baked this land into a wasteland. There is almost no soil that can support proper vegetation, and that which there is, is poor in quality.FCDescExtremeDesert
Original: The sun has baked this land into a wasteland. There is almost no soil that can support proper vegetation, and that which there is, is poor in quality.
Espanol: El sol ha cocido esta tierra hasta convertirla en un páramo. Apenas hay suelo que pueda sostener vegetación adecuada, y el que hay es de mala calidad.

Clave: matathias.empire:The vast emptiness of space stretches in all directions, broken only by the distant twinkle of stars and the occasional passing asteroid. Solar panels gleam in the eternal sunlight, while life support systems hum quietly in the artificial environment. The station floats in the void, a beacon of civilization in the cosmic wilderness.FCDescOrbitalSpace
Original: The vast emptiness of space stretches in all directions, broken only by the distant twinkle of stars and the occasional passing asteroid. Solar panels gleam in the eternal sunlight, while life support systems hum quietly in the artificial environment. The station floats in the void, a beacon of civilization in the cosmic wilderness.
Espanol: El vasto vacío del espacio se extiende en todas direcciones, roto solo por el lejano titilar de las estrellas y el ocasional asteroide que pasa. Los paneles solares relucen bajo la luz eterna del sol, mientras los sistemas de soporte vital zumban en silencio en el entorno artificial. La estación flota en el vacío, un faro de civilización en la naturaleza salvaje del cosmos.

Clave: matathias.empire:When enabled (default), a settlement's own items are forbidden and locked on manual defense maps, so you can't freely take their items. You still keep your own pawns and their gear, recover your fallen reinforcements, and may take spoils dropped by dead attackers.FCSettingRestrictDefenseMapLootTip
Original: When enabled (default), a settlement's own items are forbidden and locked on manual defense maps, so you can't freely take their items. You still keep your own pawns and their gear, recover your fallen reinforcements, and may take spoils dropped by dead attackers.
Espanol: Cuando está activado (por defecto), los objetos propios de un asentamiento quedan prohibidos y bloqueados en los mapas de defensa manual, de modo que no puedas llevarte sus objetos libremente. Conservas tus propios personajes y su equipo, recuperas a tus refuerzos caídos y puedes tomar el botín soltado por los atacantes muertos.

Clave: matathias.empire:When enabled (default), auto-resolve injuries are capped so cumulative injury severity stays under Rimworld's lethal-damage threshold and the injury path can't accidentally kill a pawn. Disable when running mods that remove or relax this check.FCSettingRespectLethalDamageThresholdTip
Original: When enabled (default), auto-resolve injuries are capped so cumulative injury severity stays under Rimworld's lethal-damage threshold and the injury path can't accidentally kill a pawn. Disable when running mods that remove or relax this check.
Espanol: Cuando está activado (por defecto), las heridas de la resolución automática se limitan para que la gravedad acumulada de las heridas se mantenga por debajo del umbral de daño letal de RimWorld y la vía de heridas no pueda matar accidentalmente a un personaje. Desactívalo cuando uses mods que eliminen o relajen esta comprobación.

Clave: matathias.empire:When enabled (default), mercenary weapons and apparel are biocoded to their wielder, and humanlike mercenaries receive a death acidifier implant that dissolves their worn gear when they die, so you can't farm free gear from your own squads.FCSettingAntiExploitTip
Original: When enabled (default), mercenary weapons and apparel are biocoded to their wielder, and humanlike mercenaries receive a death acidifier implant that dissolves their worn gear when they die, so you can't farm free gear from your own squads.
Espanol: Cuando está activado (por defecto), las armas y la ropa de los mercenarios se biocodifican a su portador, y los mercenarios humanoides reciben un implante acidificador de muerte que disuelve el equipo que llevan puesto al morir, de modo que no puedas conseguir equipo gratis de tus propios escuadrones.

Clave: matathias.empire:When enabled (default), the xenotype cost factor has no upper bound. Disable to clamp the final factor at a configurable maximum.FCSettingGeneValueFactorUnlimitedTip
Original: When enabled (default), the xenotype cost factor has no upper bound. Disable to clamp the final factor at a configurable maximum.
Espanol: Cuando está activado (por defecto), el factor de coste del xenotipo no tiene límite superior. Desactívalo para acotar el factor final en un máximo configurable.

Clave: matathias.empire:When enabled, no tithe items will be collected for this resource at tax time. Its production value will be converted to silver income instead. Your tithe settings are preserved and will resume when unpaused.FCPauseTithesDesc
Original: When enabled, no tithe items will be collected for this resource at tax time. Its production value will be converted to silver income instead. Your tithe settings are preserved and will resume when unpaused.
Espanol: Cuando está activado, no se recogerán objetos de diezmo de este recurso a la hora de los impuestos. En su lugar, su valor de producción se convertirá en ingresos de plata. Tu configuración de diezmos se conserva y se reanudará al quitar la pausa.

Clave: matathias.empire:When enabled, the Empire faction's tech level is pinned to the player faction's tech level. Research projects no longer advance the Empire's tech level.FCMirrorPlayerTechLevelDesc
Original: When enabled, the Empire faction's tech level is pinned to the player faction's tech level. Research projects no longer advance the Empire's tech level.
Espanol: Cuando está activado, el nivel tecnológico de la facción del Imperio se fija al nivel tecnológico de la facción del jugador. Los proyectos de investigación ya no avanzan el nivel tecnológico del Imperio.

Clave: matathias.empire:When enabled, the abstract force losses from an auto-resolved battle are converted into real injuries (and potentially deaths) on the participating mercenary pawns. When disabled, auto-resolve never touches squad pawns.FCSettingApplyAutoResolveInjuriesTip
Original: When enabled, the abstract force losses from an auto-resolved battle are converted into real injuries (and potentially deaths) on the participating mercenary pawns. When disabled, auto-resolve never touches squad pawns.
Espanol: Cuando está activado, las pérdidas abstractas de fuerza de una batalla resuelta automáticamente se convierten en heridas reales (y potencialmente muertes) en los mercenarios participantes. Cuando está desactivado, la resolución automática nunca afecta a los personajes del escuadrón.

Clave: matathias.empire:When enabled, the random tithe budget automatically fills the remaining projected tithe budget after your explicit tithes. Adding explicit tithes will reduce the random budget accordingly.FCAutoMaxRandomTitheDesc
Original: When enabled, the random tithe budget automatically fills the remaining projected tithe budget after your explicit tithes. Adding explicit tithes will reduce the random budget accordingly.
Espanol: Cuando está activado, el presupuesto de diezmo aleatorio rellena automáticamente los ingresos restantes tras los diezmos manuales. Añadir diezmos manuales reducirá el presupuesto aleatorio en consecuencia.

Clave: matathias.empire:While a multi-step event chain is still resolving, do not fire a new random event even if the time-between-events would allow it. Overrides the frequency setting.FCSettingBlockEventsDuringChainDesc

Espanol: Mientras una cadena de eventos de varios pasos siga resolviéndose, no dispares un nuevo evento aleatorio aunque el tiempo entre eventos lo permita. Anula el ajuste de frecuencia.

Clave: matathias.empire:While not a true desert, growing soil is at a premium thanks to the relentless heat. Most of the land is open, with secluded groves breaking the otherwise empty skyline.FCDescAridShrubland
Original: While not a true desert, growing soil is at a premium thanks to the relentless heat. Most of the land is open, with secluded groves breaking the otherwise empty skyline.
Espanol: Aunque no es un verdadero desierto, el suelo cultivable es escaso debido al calor implacable. La mayor parte de la tierra es abierta, con recónditas arboledas que rompen el horizonte por lo demás vacío.

Clave: matathias.empire:While typically less cold than the hinterland of a tundra, a boreal forest's harsh winter weather is only matched by its warm summers, where greenery briefly blooms and food becomes plentiful.FCDescBorealForest
Original: While typically less cold than the hinterland of a tundra, a boreal forest's harsh winter weather is only matched by its warm summers, where greenery briefly blooms and food becomes plentiful.
Espanol: Aunque suele ser menos frío que el interior de una tundra, el duro clima invernal de un bosque boreal solo es igualado por sus cálidos veranos, cuando la vegetación florece brevemente y la comida se vuelve abundante.

Espanol: Elimina tus políticas centrales actuales y elige otras nuevas. El coste escala con el tamaño y la prosperidad de {0}.

ogre.ogrestack:Fixed: Means each item that matches the category will have a stack size specified by the value.
(Good for items that are similar and have similar base stack sizes: like cloth and leather).

Scalar: Means each item that matches the category will have its base game stacksize multipled by the value.
(Good for items that are not similar or have vastly different base stack sizes: like manufactured).OgreStack.Settings.Mode.Desc
Original:
Fixed: Means each item that matches the category will have a stack size specified by the value.
(Good for items that are similar and have similar base stack sizes: like cloth and leather).

Scalar: Means each item that matches the category will have its base game stacksize multipled by the value.
(Good for items that are not similar or have vastly different base stack sizes: like manufactured).
Espanol:
Fijar: Cada artículo que coincida con una categoría tendrá un tamaño de apilamiento determinado por su valor.
(Bueno para artículos que son similares y tienen tamaños de apilamiento estándar similares: como tela y cuero).

Scalar: Significa que cada elemento que coincida con la categoría tendrá su tamaño de apilamiento de juego base multiplicado por el valor.
(Bueno para artículos que no son similares o que tienen tamaños de base muy diferentes: como los manufacturados).

Clave:
reel.expanded.storage:A sealed metal container designed to keep your perishable food safe, frozen, and easily accessible for both lunch and dinner. Items stored inside will not rot over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings, as long as it's powered. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 12 
Stack per tile: 6

Original:
A sealed metal container designed to keep your perishable food safe, frozen, and easily accessible for both lunch and dinner. Items stored inside will not rot over time and have no impact on the beauty of their surroundings, as long as it's powered. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Storage stats:</color> 
Stack size total: 12 
Stack per tile: 6 

Allowed items: Foods, Plant matter, Alcohol, Beverages, Musts, Hay, Condiments \n\n<color=#0094FF>Items stored can be frozen when powered.</color>
Espanol:
Un recipiente metálico sellado que conserva los alimentos perecederos congelados y accesibles para el almuerzo y la cena. Su contenido no se pudre ni afecta a la belleza del entorno mientras tenga electricidad. \n\n<color=#E5E54C>Estadísticas de almacenamiento:</color> 
Capacidad total de pilas: 12 
Pilas por casilla: 6
